question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

It is 2036. Looking back, 5 landmark papers each settled this question in a way that surprised the field, because of how they approached it. For each paper, describe what it measured, analyzed, or did, as a concrete idea a research lab could pursue today. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Lineage-resolved decay rates of AP-1 chromatin state versus transcription
ideas.description: Use clonal barcoding with paired single-cell ATAC and RNA readouts to track sister cells for many divisions after a transient stimulus, measuring separately how fast AP-1 motif accessibility and AP-1 target transcription relax toward baseline. Memory is demonstrated if accessibility half-lives substantially exceed those of both AP-1 protein levels and target mRNA.

ideas.title: Degron erasure test: is AP-1 protein required to maintain its own footprint?
ideas.description: Tag endogenous FOS/JUN family members with inducible degrons and deplete them at defined times after stimulation, then assay whether previously opened AP-1 sites stay open and whether the cell still responds faster to a second stimulus. Distinguishing a self-sustaining chromatin mark from continuous AP-1 occupancy is the crux of any memory claim.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation dose-response mapping of the primed state
ideas.description: Quantify, at single-cell resolution, the stimulus dose and latency needed to re-trigger a response in previously stimulated versus naive cells across a long range of rest intervals. A genuine memory predicts a measurable leftward shift in threshold and shortened latency that decays with a characteristic timescale, giving memory an operational, quantitative definition rather than a correlative one.

ideas.title: Mitotic bookmarking and dilution accounting across the cell cycle
ideas.description: Combine live imaging of tagged AP-1 with cell-cycle sensors and post-mitotic chromatin profiling of daughter pairs to ask whether AP-1 sites are re-established after mitosis, and whether the two daughters inherit matched or divergent states. Measuring inheritance fidelity per division turns 'memory' into a per-generation transmission probability.

ideas.title: Synthetic AP-1 site insertion to test sufficiency at a naive locus
ideas.description: Insert defined arrays of AP-1 motifs, with varied spacing and partner motifs, at neutral genomic locations alongside a reporter, then stimulate and measure whether the site autonomously acquires and retains accessibility and a faster second response. This converts the question from observational association to a sufficiency experiment with tunable sequence grammar.
